# EvTooltip

> A tooltip is a small dark overlay that appears on hover or focus to give a short, contextual hint about an element, with an arrow pointing back to its trigger.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:tooltip` |
| Layer | Molecule (`src/molecules`) |
| Import | `import { EvTooltip } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvTooltip>` or `<ev-tooltip>` |
| Source | `src/molecules/tooltip/EvTooltip.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<span class="ev-tooltip">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvTooltip
  text="Menyimpan tanpa menutup formulir"
  open
>
  <EvButton variant="secondary-light">Arahkan ke sini</EvButton>
</EvTooltip>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Props (6)

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | `'top'` \| `'bottom'` \| `'left'` \| `'right'` | `'top'` | no | Which side of the trigger the bubble sits on. |
| `text` | `string` | — | no | Body text. Use the `content` slot for anything richer. |
| `title` | `string` | — | no | Optional bold heading inside the bubble. |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | no | Take control of visibility instead of letting hover and focus drive it. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Renders the close button in the title row. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Tutup'` | no | — |

**Two-way binding:** `v-model:open`

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Tooltip**, frame `4527:86149` (Tooltip). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to give a brief, supplementary hint on hover or focus — naming an icon button, clarifying a truncated label, or explaining a control.

### When not to use

- Don't use for essential information or actions — it's hidden until hover and unavailable on touch. For rich interactive content use a Popover (`evoq-ui:popover`); for confirmations use a Modal (`evoq-ui:modal`).

### Do

- Keep it short — a phrase or one sentence. Point the arrow (Variant) toward the trigger and position it so it doesn't cover the element it describes.

### Don't

- Don't pack paragraphs, multiple actions, or critical controls into a tooltip. Don't trigger it on elements that aren't interactive or focusable.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvTooltip`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<span class="ev-tooltip">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:tooltip` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
